source: Authenticated Supabase Dashboard Logs Explorer, actual saju Shutdown events
query: SELECT count() AS shutdown_samples, min(toFloat64OrNull(log_attributes['cpu_time_used'])) AS cpu_min_ms, round(avg(toFloat64OrNull(log_attributes['cpu_time_used'])),2) AS cpu_mean_ms, quantileExact(0.95)(toFloat64OrNull(log_attributes['cpu_time_used'])) AS cpu_p95_ms, max(toFloat64OrNull(log_attributes['cpu_time_used'])) AS cpu_max_ms, groupUniqArray(log_attributes['reason']) AS shutdown_reasons, min(timestamp) AS earliest, max(timestamp) AS latest FROM logs WHERE source = 'function_logs' AND log_attributes['function_id'] = 'c3e5259a-709e-4f5e-a8e5-96ee9a6329a3' AND log_attributes['event_type'] = 'Shutdown' LIMIT 1
measurement: Supabase runtime cpu_time_used milliseconds; not HTTP wall duration or browser timing
resultScope: Observed resource smoke on the hosted saju function during synthetic integration runs. No observed CPUTime shutdown in this window.
limitations: Shutdown events measure execution/isolate CPU and are not claimed to map one-to-one to an individual test case or request.
The window includes different Saju actions, validation paths and successive deployments; this is not an isolated per-engine microbenchmark or a load test.
The observations do not guarantee worst-case latency for all valid dates, workloads, future versions, or cold starts.
Earlier 15-case engine smoke reported wall time; this new evidence supplies independently observed runtime CPU without relabelling those old measurements.
